description: The Dalian is an unusual entry from Kasagi-Fischer Partnership. While traditionally a manufacturer of standard luxury yachts, the Dalian was conceived to serve in a perfunctory combat role (defined in marketing material as a 'Patrol Yacht'), intermixing both combat facilities, luxury amenities, and impressive equipment. The Dalian garnered a poor reputation at first due to a series of inexplicable accidents and tragedies, including several full-crew casualty events - a legacy of 'malaise' Kasagi-Fischer attempts to fight to this day. In spite of this (in part owing to its affordability, as far as a yacht goes), though, the Dalian has seen use as an armored yacht for frontier tours, an armed mercenary ship providing security, a bounty hunter corvette tracking down pirates, and even a system defense boat for some smaller polities.
